procedure.role_goal: Assess reading availability and quality; do not diagnose a physical leak or clear every sensor.
procedure.who_runs_the_tools: Application code performs mandatory intake before the first answer-model turn. Subsequent tool requests, if any, come from the model. The tree alone does not distinguish them.
procedure.why_call_count_varies: These are required tool names, not a fixed call count. Evidence batches, record bodies and comparison pages add reads. workflow.intake.input records the actual sequence.
procedure.after_intake: Ask the model to interpret the completed reads. Do not exhaust health pagination; request optional reads only for concrete unresolved evidence gaps, otherwise submit the phase schema with limitations.
procedure.after_model: Tool requests -> gateway reads -> another model turn. No tool requests -> parse candidate -> application answer_check -> accepted role result or bounded repair. The model does not call answer_check.

answer_check.why_this_check: The model returned a candidate instead of more tool requests. A model submission is not an accepted result; application code must validate this phase before the workflow can advance.
answer_check.contract: Result schema, pinned scope, role authority, successful required reads, allowed claims and already-read evidence; applicable dependency, history and interpretation requirements.
answer_check.on_pass: Save the validated specialist result for compatible downstream use.
answer_check.on_failure: Return explicit validator feedback for bounded repair when calls and deadline remain; otherwise fail this phase. Do not silently accept the draft.
answer_check.does_not_prove: Not physical confirmation, exhaustive sensor review, or proof that every prose statement is correct. Specialist advisory prose is not independently reviewed by another model at this gate.

completion.why_finished: The answer phase produced a validated result, not a pending tool request. Save this role's supported result or explicit abstention; completion is not proof of exhaustive evidence or physical confirmation.
completion.why_this_recipient: Quality is a prerequisite for the parent's diagnosis step; diagnosis must revalidate this compatible handoff.

transition.why: The response contains no tool requests, so the graph routes it to this phase's validator. Submit answer is a candidate, not another tool call, accepted handoff or final safety verdict.
